note: The fuzz input supplies the next virtual smart-card response length consumed by the project fuzz reader.
The input-controlled virtual-card chunk becomes the APDU response bytes later parsed as ASN.1.

code: r = sc_asn1_decode(card->ctx, asn1_sm_response, sm_apdu->resp, sm_apdu->resplen, NULL, NULL);
note: The secure-messaging response bytes are decoded with the stack-local ASN.1 entry array.

code: r = asn1_decode_entry(ctx, entry, obj, objlen, depth);
note: The decoder advances through entries without a capacity parameter and relies on a correctly terminated stack ASN.1 entry array before dispatching an entry.
When the entry pointer is outside the stack ASN.1 entry array, reading its fields causes the stack-buffer-overflow read.
